scenario.title: Teams: the answer with the 'Ask a person' card is delivered, not 'Something went wrong'

human.click: In the staging Teams test tenant, @mention Daimon: 'reply with only TEAMS-OK'.
human.expect: TEAMS-OK delivered; no 'Something went wrong. Mention me to try again.'

human.click: Click 'Ask a person' on that answer.
human.expect: Confirmation that a person was notified; the escalation lands in the configured support channel.

human.click: @mention again in the same thread: 'reply with only TEAMS-2'.
human.expect: TEAMS-2 within 40 s, no 'came across' preamble.

human.click: @mention: 'run sleep 90 then say DONE'; driver restarts staging workers 15 s in.
human.expect: Card says Daimon restarted and to @mention it again (Teams channels need a mention, F12); not 'send a message'.

human.click: @mention: 'run sleep 60 then say DONE', press Stop after 10 s.
human.expect: Card says Stopped; no 'Done.', no 👍/👎, no ping (surfaces #8).

human.click: @mention in a channel whose SharePoint files are not granted: 'make a tiny CSV and attach it'.
human.expect: A visible 'files aren't enabled here, ask an admin' line, not a silent drop (R6/surfaces #12).
